subject.title: fix(agents): decouple MCP retirement from browser cleanup

question: Should opaque `runId` resource ownership become a supported field on every plugin tool context, or should browser cleanup receive a narrower private/runtime seam?
rationale: The synchronization fix needs a stable run identity, but choosing a permanent public Plugin SDK contract versus a browser-specific host seam is repository architecture intent rather than a mechanical correctness choice.

options.title: Approve generic run ownership
options.body: Keep the optional `runId` field, document its opacity and lifecycle guarantees, and add focused Plugin SDK contract coverage before merge.

options.title: Keep ownership browser-private
options.body: Remove the public context expansion and inject equivalent run ownership only through a narrow browser runtime boundary.

options.title: Pause the design
options.body: Hold the PR until a broader plugin resource-lifecycle contract is designed with other per-run resource owners.

recommendation.title: Approve generic run ownership
recommendation.body: Keep the optional `runId` field, document its opacity and lifecycle guarantees, and add focused Plugin SDK contract coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent cleanup-race work provides the best available routing signal for this lifecycle/API decision.
